children: may bounce further toward $3.1955 per lb, as it has stabilized around a support at $3.0575 and broken a resistance at $3.1335.
The next resistance will be at $3.1955. The bounce is classified as a pullback toward a rising trendline. It may end around the $3.1955 to $3.2150 range.
Support is at $3.0925, a break below which could trigger a fall into the range of $3.0050-$3.0575.
